entries.en:
Outside the bathhouse, you reunite with Tolas, who has promptly dressed himself in his full armor. The two of you decide to make for the road just outside Radisca's Round, where it is believed that Mauwyl's caravan was attacked. Hurry to your destination, and pray that the young woodcutter has not already come to harm.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en: Arriving at the scene of the ambush, you encounter a soldier who shares with you and Tolas the latest tidings regarding the search effort. It would appear that all the missing members have been found and led to safety, with the notable exception of Mauwyl, who remains unaccounted for. With time of the essence, Tolas suggests that you split up, that you might cover the most ground in your search efforts. The guardsman offers to search in the vicinity of Wolves of Shadow, and bids you sweep the southern edge of the forest for any signs of the young woodcutter.
entries.fr: Tolas et vous avez décidé de vous séparer pour partir à la recherche de Mauwyl. Suivez ses in<->struc<->tions et rendez-vous dans les bois à l'est de Rouillechaînes pour tenter de le retrouver.

entries.en: Your search for Mauwyl has thus far proven less than fruitful, while a pair of nasty sin eaters' search for something to eat─namely, you─has proven more so. Fortunately, you are able to make quick work of your foe. The path clear, you resolve to continue to probe the forests for any sign of the missing woodcutter.

entries.en: You have completed your search of the forest, but Mauwyl is nowhere to be found. You have no choice but to return to Radisca's Round and hope that Tolas's efforts have borne more fruit than your own.
entries.fr: Vous n'avez pas réussi à trouver Mauwyl malgré vos efforts. Retrouvez Tolas à l'endroit indiqué pour faire le point.

entries.en: As you are retracing your path back to Radisca's Round, you come upon a sight that is at once both startling and reassuring: Tolas standing over a vanquished sin eater with Mauwyl trembling by his side. It would appear that the guardsman came upon the woodcutter just as he was about to become dinner for the fiend, and succeeded in overcoming his demons to vanquish the foe and save the young man's life. Tolas explains that traveling and conversing with you have returned to him a measure of clarity and peace, freeing him from the paralyzing effects of his lingering fear and shame. Both men say their thanks, then set off for the Ostall Imperative, bidding you visit them there so that they might properly express their gratitude.
entries.fr: Alors que vous rejoigniez Tolas, vous l'avez trouvé sauvant Mauwyl des griffes d'un purgateur errant. Cette situation semble avoir provoqué un déclic en lui, et il a réussi à vaincre ses angoisses pour combattre. Retrouvez-le à L'Impératif d'Ostall pour faire le point.
entries.ja: トーラスの元に駆け付けると、マウィルを襲ったはぐれ罪喰いを、トーラスが撃退していた。彼は冒険者との語らいで、戦う理由を再度見つけたようだ。レイクランドのオスタル厳命城で「トーラス」と話そう。

entries.en: Back at the Imperative, Tolas and Mauwyl once again thank you for everything you have done on their behalf. The guardsman, especially, explains that it is because of you that he has rediscovered his sense of purpose and the will to fight. Mauwyl pays his respects and heads out to make a delivery, and Tolas prepares to return to his post, leaving you with an open invitation to visit him and his brothers-in-arms at the Imperative any time you like.
entries.fr: Visiblement, Tolas a réussi à surmonter son traumatisme et semble prêt à tourner la page. Il a retrouvé une nouvelle motivation pour effectuer son devoir et semble désormais confiant et positif envers l'avenir.

entries.en: When the sin eaters came that day, I felt fear as I had never felt before. My pride as a warrior, the lives of the men under my command, all were consumed by a primal urge for survival.
entries.fr: Moi aussi, j'étais concentré sur ma propre survie lors de la fameuse attaque. Après, j'ai eu honte de n'avoir pas réussi à sauver mes camarades.
entries.ja:
あの襲撃のとき、俺は生き残ることに必死だった。
そして、仲間を救えなかった自分を恥じた。
entries.jaMacro:
あの襲撃のとき、俺は生き残ることに必死だった。
そして、仲間を救えなかった自分を恥じた。
entries.speaker: TOLAS

entries.en: And so on that day, faced with my greatest test, with the chance to truly do my ancestors proud, I shrank from the challenge rather than rising to it. And I have cursed myself every moment since.
entries.fr: Je voulais être comme mon ancêtre, mais j'ai cédé à la peur et je n'ai pas été à la hauteur... Je le regrette énormément.
entries.ja:
誇り高き騎士だった曽祖父のようにありたいと願いながら、
恐怖に屈して、仲間を見捨てた自分を恥じて、悔いた。
entries.jaMacro:
誇り高き騎士だった曽祖父のようにありたいと願いながら、
恐怖に屈して、仲間を見捨てた自分を恥じて、悔いた。
entries.speaker: TOLAS

entries.en: What I would not give to have that day over again. If I had stood with my men on the front lines, served as their shield, how many lives could I have saved? That one thought grabbed hold of my mind, and would not release its grasp.
entries.fr: Si j'avais tenu le coup sans m'enfuir, si j'avais réagi plus vite, j'aurais pu les défendre, j'aurais pu les sauver. Depuis le combat, cette pensée m'obsède.
entries.ja:
あのとき、退かずに戦っていれば、
もっと早く、剣を振るっていれば、仲間の盾になっていれば。
……ずっとそんなことを考えていた。
entries.jaMacro:
あのとき、退かずに戦っていれば、
もっと早く、剣を振るっていれば、仲間の盾になっていれば。
……ずっとそんなことを考えていた。
entries.speaker: TOLAS

entries.en: Since then, every time I faced an enemy, the image would appear in front of me. The image of me on that day, retreating to the rear as my men fought in vain against a horrible foe.
entries.fr: Alors que je me morfondais dans cet état, vous êtes apparu<if(gnum4,e,)> devant moi.
entries.ja:
そうしているうちに、何としても生き残ろうと、
醜く足掻く俺自身の姿が、目の前に浮かぶようになった。
entries.frMacro: Alors que je me morfondais dans cet état, vous êtes apparu<if(gnum4,e,)> devant moi.
entries.jaMacro:
そうしているうちに、何としても生き残ろうと、
醜く足掻く俺自身の姿が、目の前に浮かぶようになった。
entries.speaker: TOLAS

entries.en: Every time I so much as grasped the hilt of my blade, it would all come flooding back. The sight of my men falling, the spatters of blood... And the screams...always the screams...
entries.fr: ... Il y a autre chose. Depuis ce jour funeste, je ne parviens pas à oublier les voix de mes camarades tombant sous les coups des purgateurs. À chaque instant elles résonnent dans ma tête... Le simple fait de saisir la gaine de mon épée ravive ce souvenir et me fait trembler.
entries.ja:
それだけじゃない。
死んでいった仲間の、最期の悲鳴が頭から離れなくなって、
剣を手にしただけで震えが走るようになってしまった。

entries.en: Tolas...
entries.fr: Tolas...
entries.ja: トーラス……。
entries.speaker: MAUWYL

entries.en: The day may never come that I can fully forgive myself for my cowardice. But in talking to <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, there is one thing I now understand.
entries.macro: The day may never come that I can fully forgive myself for my cowardice. But in talking to <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, there is one thing I now understand.
entries.fr: Mais après avoir discuté avec <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, j'ai enfin réussi à sortir de l'impasse.
entries.ja:
……だが、, ,1)>殿と語らい、
その想いを聞くことで、俺の迷いも晴れたようだ。
entries.frMacro: Mais après avoir discuté avec <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, j'ai enfin réussi à sortir de l'impasse.

entries.en: If I allow myself to be haunted by the shame and the specters of that day, I will only repeat the mistakes of the past. No, I must overcome my grief and bitter regret─and fight on, for the sake of those I still might yet protect.
entries.fr: Je me suis remémoré mes raisons de me battre. Le simple sentiment de vouloir protéger ses compagnons... C'était pour cela que j'avais choisi la voie de l'épée, au départ.
entries.ja:
俺は戦う理由を思い出した。
仲間を、友を守りたいという単純な想い……
剣の道を志した理由は、たったそれだけだったのだ。

entries.en: But I could not have accomplished that alone. No, I could not have accomplished it without you at my side, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>.
entries.macro: But I could not have accomplished that alone. No, I could not have accomplished it without you at my side, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>.
entries.fr: Et puis, je me suis aussi souvenu de vos combats avec les purgateurs. Quand je vous ai entendu<if(gnum4,e,)> combattre, j'ai ressenti une grande puissance émanant de vous.
entries.ja:
それに、, ,1)>殿。
貴方が罪喰いと戦う音が聞こえたとき、
俺は、かつてない心強さを感じたのだ。

entries.en: As I watched you fighting beside me─with an unflinching sense of purpose, despite all the horrors you have seen─for the first time since the battle that day, my sword arm ceased trembling, and I felt a measure of peace.
entries.fr: En vous ayant à mes côtés, les tremblements qui me paralysaient se sont soudain calmés. J'avais tout d'un coup repris confiance.
entries.ja:
貴方が傍で戦ってくれている。
そう考えただけで、自然と手の震えが収まって、
また戦えるような気がした。

entries.en: You have done more for me than you will ever know. For this, I thank you.
entries.fr: Tout ça, c'est grâce à vous. Je vous dois vraiment beaucoup.
entries.ja:
何もかも、貴方のおかげだ。
ありがとう。
entries.jaMacro:
何もかも、貴方のおかげだ。
ありがとう。
entries.speaker: TOLAS

entries.en: There is more I would say, but that can wait for another time. Mauwyl, we should return to the Imperative─doubtless I was not the only one worried sick about you. You are more than welcome to join us, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, if there is not somewhere else you must be.
entries.macro: There is more I would say, but that can wait for another time. Mauwyl, we should return to the Imperative─doubtless I was not the only one worried sick about you. You are more than welcome to join us, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, if there is not somewhere else you must be.
entries.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, je ne vais pas rester trop tard, il faut que je raccompagne Mauwyl. Pourrez-vous me retrouver à L'Impératif plus tard<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
話は尽きないが、ずっとここにいるわけにもいくまい、
マウィルは俺が厳命城に送り届けよう。
後ほど、貴方も城まで来てもらえるだろうか？

出発するぞ！

entries.en: There is one more thing I realized reflecting on the matter. In my all-consuming desire to prove my valor and do my family proud, I lost sight of the most important reason that I fight.
entries.fr: Je m'efforçais d'être digne de mon illustre ancêtre, mais j'ai peut-être perdu de vue l'essentiel à force de me concentrer sur la force pure.
entries.ja:
曽祖父のように立派でありたいという思いが、
いつの間にか強くなりすぎていたのだろう。
周りが見えなくなっていたようだ。
entries.jaMacro:

entries.en: From today, I will put such lofty goals out of my mind─along with my past demons, as best as I am able─and fight as best I can for those who need me today.
entries.fr: J'ai compris beaucoup de choses. Je vais continuer d'œuvrer pour défendre les innocents aux côtés de mes camarades.
entries.ja:
これからは仲間たちと共に、
俺のできることで、人々の暮らしを護っていきたい。
entries.jaMacro:
これからは仲間たちと共に、

entries.en: You have taught me an important lesson today...both of you.
entries.fr: Si j'ai réussi à mûrir de la sorte, c'est grâce à Mauwyl et à vous.
entries.ja: そう思えるようになったのは、貴方と、マウィルのおかげだ。
entries.speaker: TOLAS

entries.en: Hah! That's right! I was wondering when you were going to get around to thanking the man who brought <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)> here from the Crystarium in the first place! Which reminds me─I have a delivery to make!

entries.fr: Heureux d'avoir pu t'aider, mon ami<nbsp>! Je vais à présent aller saluer mes compagnons du convoi, ils ont dû se faire un sang d'encre pendant que j'avais disparu. Et puis, j'ai encore une livraison qui m'attend.
entries.ja:
へへ、感謝してくれよ？
それじゃあボクは、輸送隊の皆に無事を伝えてくるよ。
クリスタリウムに、また納品に行かなきゃいけないしね。

entries.en: Should you ever need a respite from the road, you are always welcome at the Imperative. Though we can offer little else, I hope that you will honor us with your presence again one day.
entries.fr: J'espère que vous reviendrez me voir à L'Impératif. Je serai toujours heureux de vous revoir.
